description:
Make a gate evaluation carry its validation base's decode outcome, failure included, to the fallback, and make declaration reads return the final discovery round's derivation, so no input is resolved twice per captured image.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs` ~1055: `.ok()` discards the validation base's issue-decode failure; the fallback at ~1162 decodes the same image again, including records already decoded (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs` ~802 stops at the first malformed issue).
- `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs` ~2807: `captured_declarations_with` derives the final discovery bundle, discards it, and derives it again at ~2814, so an ordinary read (e.g. `jit item list`) resolves the registry and rebuilds effective rules twice for its final image.
- Story `d675102c` sol re-checkpoint r4 (commit `b098a6bd6`), finding 1 (blocking, REQ-04) and advisory finding 2 (`@/charter/D-20`). Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): both in scope as one task; the failure path is held to once-per-image as in the `c31c2e57` failed-assembly ruling; discarding a decode outcome with `.ok()` is the defect.
- Epic criteria: `b697a3f7` REQ-10, REQ-12.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A gate evaluation whose validation base fails to decode an issue carries the decode outcome (the decode error, which the fallback reports without decoding the image again) to the fallback, which decodes no record of that image again; the evaluation reports the same error as before.
- [hard] REQ-02: `test_gate_evaluation_resolves_its_inputs_once_per_captured_image` is extended with an `IssueValidation` evaluation over a valid issue and a lexically later malformed issue, asserting each record decodes at most once per image; it fails on the parent commit.
- [hard] REQ-03: `captured_declarations_with` returns the final discovery round's derivation instead of deriving it again; one assertion in `test_configuration_parse_parses_each_distinct_source_once_across_captures` shows a declaration read resolves the registry once for its final image, failing on the parent.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every `.ok()`, `Result`-to-`Option` conversion or `unwrap_or_default` applied to a decode, derivation or capture result on gate-evaluation and declaration-read paths in `crates/jit/src` is converted when it causes a later re-resolution; the worker's report lists each remaining one with a one-line reason it causes none.
- [hard] REQ-05: Gate verdicts, validation findings, error messages and recorded evidence are unchanged.

## Rulings

- Steward amendment (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): REQ-01's parenthetical replaced; the ruled property is that no record decodes twice and the error is preserved, and partial records nothing reads would be dead data (`@/charter/D-18`). Converting `ImageInputs::load`'s `captured_gates(image).ok()` to a carried registry outcome is in scope under REQ-04.


- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09), final rework: on the discovery path in `commands/mod.rs` and its callees, a decode or derivation failure propagates immediately with `?` and its typed error, ending the command with the same error assembly would report; it is never discarded for assembly to recompute. Outcome-carrying made unnecessary by propagation is removed. Paths that deliberately continue past an error to report several errors (e.g. `jit validate`) keep carrying the outcome and are listed. One test shows a malformed `rules.toml` fails with the unchanged error and derives once; it covers the class.
title: Gate evaluation and declaration reads carry their decode and derivation outcomes
